create_mcap_message_writer: create an McapMessageWriter instance with a FileHandler and optional queue size limit
reset_file_handler: reset the file handler with a new output file prefix and start timestamp
start_writer_thread: start the background worker thread to process messages from the queue asynchronously
write_proto_message: write a protobuf message to the mcap log file with topic and publish timestamp
stop_writer_and_finalize: flush the message queue, stop the worker thread, and finalize the mcap file
